item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded: A pattern you are likely to see from this author: when I have a dream, and I remember it, I will incorporate elements of it into my works. In this case, Brainy's dream(?) sequence was 90% fueled by a dream I had of exploring a colossal surrealist art gallery in the midst of a black landscape. The original dream also had me seeing a woman fall off a train and hold onto a cliff, yelling at her husband to help her. Her husband, along with her kids, just stared at her and then walked off. It was an odd dream. Anyways, yeah. Three chapters in, and the tale series name finally makes sense, don't it? ;P
